loss: same positive-weighted BCE; mean within supervised clip, then equal mean across clips
optimizer_step: one step per supervised clip; accumulated 64-frame truncated gradients divided by number of sampled targets in that clip
validation: clip-balanced candidate loss on old 79 human references plus 48 coverage-derived high-score negatives; val labels never enter optimization
selection: minimum validation candidate loss independently for each method, not FAR
initialization: same fresh seed42 full parameter state for both; identical query+MLP tensors; freeze encoder; current-only freezes unused history parameters
history_write: unchanged confidence-gated per-frame memory writes, not FSM-event writes; final support/acceptance always common old FSM
correction_to_fsm: add residual equally to intact and cleft score channels only when original image gate passes; unchanged other channels and unchanged FSM thresholds
budget: exactly 15 epochs each, one seed, no tuning; budget fixed to avoid early stopping confound
